title: The Way of Salvation
subtitle: The Way to Meet God
intro: In life we often find ourselves facing problems we cannot solve — family problems, work problems, problems with our children, spiritual problems, physical problems, and an uncertain future always lie before us. So some people fall into drugs or alcohol, or wander aimlessly. Finding no answer, others lean on religion, superstition, shamanism, money, or power. Why do these problems come? And what is the real solution?

sections.title: Man as Originally Created

items.title: Created in the image of God

sections.note: The principle of creation: as fish belong in water, birds in the sky, and trees in the soil — people are only truly happy when they are with God.

sections.title: Six Problems of Man Apart from God

items.title: A child of the devil — bound by fate
items.body:
[[JOH 8:44]] [[EPH 2:1]]
Apart from God, man is spiritually dead and under the rule of Satan.

items.title: Idolatry — enslaved to the devil
items.body:
[[1CO 10:20]] [[EPH 2:2]]
As a result, people fall into superstition and idolatry — fortune-telling, rituals, good works — yet find no happiness, and live bound by fate, checking lucky days, directions, and burial sites.

items.title: Problems of the heart and mind
items.body:
[[MAT 11:28]] [[EPH 2:3]]
Anxiety, discontent, emptiness, mental illness, neurosis, insomnia, depression… even with good background, knowledge, and money, there is no true peace.

items.title: Physical problems and disease
items.body:
[[ACT 8:4-8]]
Incurable diseases, troubles, nightmares, and sleep paralysis; suffering from pain throughout the body with no diagnosis.

items.title: The life to come — death, judgment, hell
items.body:
[[LUK 16:19-31]] [[HEB 9:27]]
Denying God and clinging only to this life, man finally dies and faces eternal judgment in hell.

items.title: Problems for the next generation — spiritual inheritance
items.body:
[[EXO 20:4-5]]
In the end, all these problems are passed down to our children.

prayer.title: Prayer to Receive Christ
prayer.body: God of love! I did not know You, and until now I have lived as I pleased. But now I believe that Jesus is the Christ who died on the cross for me and rose again. I open the door of my heart and receive Jesus as my Savior. Please come into my heart and lead me forever. I pray in the name of the living Jesus Christ. Amen.

items.title: A child of God — set free from fate
items.body:
[[JOH 1:12]]
Having received Jesus Christ, you are a child of God.

items.title: The Holy Spirit dwells in you, guides and protects
items.body:
[[1CO 3:16]] [[JOH 14:26-27]]
The Holy Spirit is always with you and leads you.

items.title: The work of the Spirit — answered prayer
items.body:
[[JOH 14:13-14]] [[JOH 16:24]]
When you pray to God in the name of Jesus Christ, He answers.

items.title: Authority over the powers of darkness
items.body:
[[MAR 3:13-15]] [[LUK 10:19]] [[MAT 12:28-29]]
In the name of Jesus Christ you can break and overcome the forces of Satan.

items.title: Help from angels — ministering spirits
items.body:
[[HEB 1:14]] [[REV 8:3-5]]
God sends His heavenly hosts and angels to protect you.

items.title: Citizen of heaven — eternal blessing
items.body:
[[PHI 3:20]] [[JOH 5:24]]
As God's people holding heavenly citizenship, you can enjoy its blessings even on this earth.

items.title: World evangelization — the blessing of mission
items.body:
[[MAT 28:16-20]] [[ACT 1:8]]
We have regained the authority to conquer and rule the world with the Gospel.
